messages:
olivia: Quick alert  we enabled strict fncall schema enforcement on route `file_extract` in a small canary (route 0xfee). Console shows a bump in hard rejects (~0.5% of the slice) and a couple customer tickets. Looks like adapters are returning an array for `pages` instead of the expected object. Anyone on routing vs validator?

mateo: I own routing. Can you paste a sample?

olivia: From logs:
```json
{"fn":"file_extract","pages":[{"num":1,"text":"..."}],"meta":{"partner":"pdf-partner"}}
```
We expect `pages` -> `{count:int, items:[{num:int,text:string}]}` so single-array payloads fail the validator.

sylvie: Validator owner here. We switched to reject to catch schema drift early. Canary sample was supposed to be small but partner mix is heavier than expected. Were reject events being sampled?

olivia: Canary telemetry was 100% for visibility; ops is seeing pager noise.

hiro: Ops suggestion: flip the validator to "soft-pass" for canary: increment `fncall.strict_rejects` with tags {route, partner}, return 200 with header `X-Fncall-Validation: soft-pass`, and set `tool_passthrough:true`. That preserves metrics but avoids client-facing 4xx.

sylvie: I can push that fast. Also propose we capture a small sample (0.5%) of failing payloads to s3://fncall/reject-samples/ with partner and route tags (PII redaction). Without samples triage is guesswork.

mateo: For routing: I'll add a temporary rule that if `meta.partner` in a quarantine set -> route to `file_extract-compat`. That variant will accept both array and object shapes. Ops can add partners to the quarantine set as we identify them.

olivia: Product/console ask: can we add a dashboard breakdown for `fncall.strict_rejects` by `meta.partner` + `route_id` and highlight canary slices? Right now graphs are model-level which hides partner concentration.

hiro: deploy-bot: toggle requested by @sylvie to set validator soft-pass on route 0xfee for canary. CI quick checks ok. ETA ~5m.

sylvie: Patch merged; canary soft-pass active. Metric `fncall.strict_rejects` still increments with tag `ingest_origin:canary_softpass` so backfills can filter. Sampling hook enabled.

mateo: Quarantine rule implemented. I added `pdf-partner` to the quarantine list and routed their traffic to `file_extract-compat` for the next 48h while they update adapters. No measurable latency impact so far.

olivia: Thanks. Follow-ups: @mateo keep an eye on routing proxy CPU; @sylvie produce a short incident note with counts and the metric query; @hiro add console tile and link to sample bucket; team to decide after 48h whether to require adapter changes or keep compat route.

hiro: Added dashboard tile under fncall -> validation issues. It breaks warns/rejects by partner and route. Links to samples bucket.

sylvie: Will share postmortem and a suggested coercion library for common cases (array->object, null->empty) for partners to adopt.

olivia: Closing loop for now. We'll re-evaluate after the 48h quarantine window. :white_check_mark:
